description: Client-side script for the 'Cost Center' doctype in ERPNext, handling form events, UI interactions, and custom actions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form queries and UI elements when the Cost Center form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates UI elements, buttons, and info text when the form is refreshed.

methods.name: update_cost_center_number
methods.description: Opens a dialog to update the cost center's name and number, and processes the update.

methods.name: parent_cost_center
methods.description: Validates that the company is entered before selecting a parent cost center.

methods.name: hide_unhide_group_ledger
methods.description: Adds buttons to convert between group and ledger types based on current state.

methods.name: convert_to_group
methods.description: Converts a ledger-type cost center to a group type.

methods.name: convert_to_ledger
methods.description: Converts a group-type cost center to a ledger type.
